answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ledge only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, ivory is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any beacon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
